|game_text=Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation{{!}}Quiet Mining Colony]] or [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation{{!}}Independent Operation]] on table, lightsabers may not add to Force drains or 'swing' more than once per battle. [[Cloud City Celebration]] is canceled.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Jabba, This Is Your Last Chance!]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-79-Jabba_This_Is_Your_Last_Chance-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Jabba, This Is Your Last Chance!]].
* '''Original''' ([[Jabba, This Is Your Last Chance!]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If Quiet Mining Colony or Independent Operation on table, lightsabers may not add to Force drains. Cloud City Celebration is canceled.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Jabba, This Is Your Last Chance! (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) added “or 'swing' more than once per battle”: “Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If Quiet Mining Colony or Independent Operation on table, lightsabers may not add to Force drains or 'swing' more than once per battle. Cloud City Celebration is canceled.”.<ref name="cl-1261_80-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The swing clause is already in the Players Committee's own Holotable card data of 29 May 2010, so this text existed by that date (card data, not a printed or announced source)<ref name="cdf-20100529-light">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100529” (lightside.cdf; card data, not a printed source), as committed on 13 July 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit 5047de0)</ref>.
